description: fix/imposed-drawback-cap-bypass (code-review finding): the cap exemption rests on an imposed drawback paying NO AP, so it needs cost >= 0 as well as dmEdit. A dmEdit-flagged Peg Leg with cost -4 (it GRANTS +4 AP) on a DEX 16 Fighter stays capped: the AP loan the cap polices is real here. dm_edit_character_log does not check a drawback's cost server-side, so the engine must not trust the flag alone.

events.label: dmEdit-flagged Peg Leg that pays +4 AP
